description: Physical-device rows that must be executed and passing before an xcframework can be released. Derived from the acceptance criteria of issue 88. Simulator runs never satisfy a row.

scenarios.summary: Finite VOD: play, pause, scrub, skip forward and back from the PiP controls
Live stream with indefinite duration: PiP controls reflect an unbounded range
Restore from the PiP window back into the app
Close the PiP window with the X control
PiP start refused or failing, surfaced rather than silent
Same-player media replacement while PiP is active
Phone call or Siri interruption, and a route change such as Bluetooth disconnect
Audio continues with the app backgrounded
Sustained network stall and recovery while in PiP
